content_column: Single centered reading column, max-width 680-760px, side padding 20-24px. Body prose, stat callouts and most charts live here.

full_bleed.when: Teaser/hero, signature map or chart, chapter-break image/video. Use sparingly for impact.
full_bleed.css: width:100vw; margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw); margin-right:calc(50% - 50vw); max-width:none. Never use the old left:50% hack. Clear inherited max-width on any wrapper.
full_bleed.hero: Full viewport (height:100vh, min-height ~560px) for the opening teaser only.

section_rhythm.structure: Teaser (full-bleed) -> headline+dek -> alternating prose/visual sections, each <section> a distinct beat -> references footer.
section_rhythm.dividers: Hairline top-border (var(--line)) between sections; generous vertical padding.
section_rhythm.pacing: Vary the visual mode between consecutive sections; never 3 charts in a row without a non-chart beat (image, map, stat, quote, interactive).

visual_blocks.rule: Every non-text element sits in its own block container with margin:2rem 0, display:block, clear:both. Images/charts centered with max-width:100%.
visual_blocks.cross_ref: Matches the Programmer's layout_rules.json; this file is the design intent, that one is the enforcement detail.

grid.cards: Responsive card decks: CSS grid (repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px,1fr))) or horizontal scroll-snap for swipeable decks.
grid.stat_trio: flex row, wraps to stack on mobile.

sticky: For scrollytelling: sticky visual panel (position:sticky; top:...) beside a scrolling text column; collapse to stacked on mobile.

rules: reduce column padding and stat sizes on small screens
